---
title: Data sets
---


The complete data set for a text with musical notation includes:

- parallel editions of text and notation
- text editions included for both canonical level and token level citation
- DSE indexing of text, image and physical surface
- catalogs of: cited images, artifacts and audio

Image service: [here](https://neelsmith.github.io/mousike/mousike-images.html#catalog=https%3A%2F%2Fshot.holycross.edu%2Fimages%2Fmousike%2Fcatalog.cex)
